gloss: the present moment, at this point

definitions.gloss: the present moment, at this point in time
definitions.explanation: Refers to the current point in time, emphasizing that a situation or assessment is based on the present circumstances and may change. Common in formal reports, news, and business communication.

examples.japanese: {現時点|げんじてん}では{未定|みてい}です。
examples.english: It is undecided at this point.

examples.japanese: {現時点|げんじてん}で{分|わ}かっている{情報|じょうほう}をお{伝|つた}えします。
examples.english: I will share the information that is known at this time.

examples.japanese: {現時点|げんじてん}での{被害|ひがい}{状況|じょうきょう}は{把握|はあく}しきれていないが、{今後|こんご}{詳|くわ}しく{調査|ちょうさ}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The extent of the damage at this point has not been fully grasped, but a detailed investigation is planned going forward.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle で as {現時点|げんじてん}で or {現時点|げんじてん}では to mean "at this point in time." Implies that the situation may change in the future. Common in news reports, official statements, and business communication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現時点|げんじてん}では (at the present moment)
- {現時点|げんじてん}での{情報|じょうほう} (information as of now)
- {現時点|げんじてん}で{分|わ}かっていること (what is known at this point)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現在|げんざい}: currently, at present (more general, used in both formal and informal contexts)
- {今|いま}のところ: for now, at this point (more conversational)
- {目下|もっか}: at present, currently (formal, literary)
